The '''Gnithia system''' was a part of the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the creature known as the [[Gnithian oep]] as well as a [[Gnithian insect|species]] of [[Insect/Legends|insect]].<ref name="Truce" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gnithia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-7.<ref name="TEA" />
